## Featured Open-Source Contributions
- Canonical LXD (PR #18852): Fixed async API race condition in operation wait endpoint and aligned agent behavior (Go).
- Linux Foundation FabricOps (PR #35): Added YAML serialization support for fabricopsctl status CLI (Go).
- Canvas API MCP (PR #25): Hardened HTTP error handling and prevented credential token leakage (Python).
- kprompt (PR #113): Implemented planner-level gatekeeper rejecting unsupported Kubernetes scale kinds (Go).
- LazyFTP (PR #57): Fixed visible row boundary calculation in terminal UI processes panel (Go).
- LibreDesk (PR #452): Resolved inline CSS dark mode text invisibility issue (Vue/SCSS).
